items.title: PingCap TiDB リーク
items.summary: 📝 For one, they seem to have zero visibility into their own cloud services. Their VPC CIDRs are included; their cluster versions and endpoint hostnames are included; for the unlucky ones pasted into support tickets, so are their credentials. PingCAP's engineers paste customers' production credentials into Jira tickets.🔤 Original: PingCap TiDB Leaks🔗 Read more: https://fulcrumsec.vg/pingcap/
